items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think it was mostly let Jo chose them, anybody with the kind of taste she has, shouldn't be told what to do.

ctx.x: Whose choice of tunes was it primarily Jo’s or did you have some suggestions for tunes or did Irving?
I think it was mostly let Jo chose them, anybody with the kind of taste she has, shouldn't be told what to do.
And around the same time you did the Mel Tormé record, I Like Duke, I Like the Count. [I Dig the Duke! I Dig the Count!]
